baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Form II active participle al-mukadhdhibina at focus word 3 names agents, while the prefixed li- makes them the target of wayl.
baseline_models.mechanism: The falsehood and attribution branches combine agency with an object: these are not merely mistaken people but people who treat a claim or its bearer as false in word or deed.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood opposed to truth, including falsehood in speech or action, broadens the named agency beyond an incorrect opinion.
Actively declaring a person or report false supplies the participle's central relational act.

changed_reading.before: A generic curse upon liars or unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: A sentence directed at agents who actively assign falsehood to a claim or bearer and enact that assignment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same active participle at word 3 can carry a peripheral root image in which a charge proves true only by being carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: The charge branch treats truth and falsity as performance under pressure; mapped cautiously to the focus, denial becomes a stance claiming it can survive encounter, and wayl anticipates the failure of that claim.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves true by completion or false by failure supplies a performative test for the deniers' stance.

changed_reading.before: The deniers merely pronounce something false.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is itself a claim whose truth is tested by whether it holds when the denied reality arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispatch carries reminder and warning, the threat is promised, the promised thing falls into fixed occurrence, and the day separates truth from falsehood. The focus participle is therefore one side of an evidence-to-verdict process in which its own declaration is reversed.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report or bearer false anchors the focus as the assertion that the sequence will overturn.
The messenger-and-message image identifies an authorized transmission available to be denied.
A reminder that causes recollection gives the transmitted material a corrective function.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the message's preventive purpose before judgment.
A threat directed toward future harm supplies the content whose credibility is contested.
Falling and becoming fixed converts the promised future from report into accomplished event.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood makes the event an adjudication of the deniers' attribution.

structural_cues: 77:1-14 moves from dispatch through warning and promised occurrence to yawm al-fasl; the refrain first appears at 77:15 and recurs at the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transmission, warning, promise, occurrence, and separation; I infer a directional chain from notice to public disconfirmation. A live alternative is that these are parallel signs rather than causal stages.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns an unspecified act of denial.
changed_reading.after: It condemns rejection of a transmitted warning at the point when the warned event itself adjudicates and reverses that rejection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical formula is a mobile verdict rather than a one-off curse: each return gathers a different proof or consequence under the same agent noun, while the focus instance specifically seals the first-to-later destruction sequence.

activation_trace.role: The focus attribution-of-falsehood branch supplies the stable charge carried by the refrain.
The same active charge at the first refrain establishes recurrence before the focus instance.
Its return after the creation sequence shows the charge being reapplied to a new evidentiary unit.
The final refrain preserves the same charge immediately before the closing question about belief.

structural_cues: The exact focus formula occurs at 77:15, 19, 24, 28, 34, 37, 40, 45, 47, and 49, repeatedly closing unequal-length scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition at scene boundaries; I infer that each recurrence classifies the preceding scene as evidence against denial and resets the next test. It may alternatively function primarily as cadence without transferring every scene into the noun's object.

changed_reading.after: 77:19 is the second application of a recurring verdict, closing historical destruction while participating in a surah-wide classification of denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Destruction of those who came first is followed by later people in an ordered succession and named as an enacted treatment of criminals. The focus category shifts from an epistemic error to culpable conduct with repeatable historical liability.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in speech or action anchors denial as conduct capable of bearing liability.
Falling into destruction supplies the consequence applied to the first group.
Beginning and precedence marks that destroyed group as the first term of a sequence.
Succession one after another provides the mechanism that extends the consequence.
Later status after the first identifies the next population exposed to the same rule.
Bringing about an act makes the consequence deliberate rather than an accidental historical pattern.
Crime and culpable offense juridically classify the conduct enclosed by the refrains.

structural_cues: The same refrain at 77:15 and 77:19 brackets the complete 77:16-18 first/later/criminal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destruction, temporal succession, deliberate action, and criminals; I infer that the closing refrain reads the sequence back onto the deniers as culpable historical actors. Mujrimun could remain a broader class rather than a strict synonym for mukadhdhibin.

changed_reading.before: Deniers are wrong thinkers addressed at one moment.
changed_reading.after: They are a juridically legible class whose enacted denial enters a repeated first-to-later history of consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Weak reproductive water is deliberately formed, transformed, settled securely, and carried to a known measured limit by enabling power. This reliable embodied process activates the focus branch of a charge proving or failing: denial is tested inside a process that repeatedly reaches its appointed result.

activation_trace.role: A charge that succeeds by being carried through or fails by stopping supplies the focus-side performance test.
Proportioning and measuring a thing begins the context's calibrated developmental process.
Reproductive fluid in the womb supplies the process's material starting point.
Lowliness and weakness establish the starting material's apparent insufficiency.
Making one thing become a condition supplies the transition from material to placed state.
Fixity and settlement provide continuity rather than premature failure.
Enabling and empowerment make the settled place functionally capable.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies the developmental terminus.
Disclosure to knowledge marks that limit as known rather than accidental.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 forms one material-developmental sequence immediately after the focus and is closed by the same refrain at 77:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies weak material, transformation, secure placement, measure, and knowledge; I infer that successful completion tests the deniers' stance. The live alternative is that the sequence evidences creative power without specifically activating the performance branch of k-dh-b.

changed_reading.before: The focus denial concerns an unspecified proposition outside the deniers.
changed_reading.after: It is a failed claim made by beings whose own measured development exhibits a process that carries weak matter reliably to completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lower plane acts as a gathering container for living and dead, is stabilized, and supplies drinkable sweet water. The focus judgment can therefore address deniers from inside a system that presently bears, sustains, and eventually receives them.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution of falsehood anchors the human stance set against the containing order.
The lower plane opposite the sky supplies the physical field of containment.
Gathering and holding in a vessel makes the earth function as an encompassing container.
Living animate beings supply one population held by that container.
Loss of life supplies the opposed population ultimately held in the same field.
Fixity and rooted stability supply structural anchoring within the container.
Giving drink supplies active sustenance rather than passive enclosure alone.
Sweet fresh water specifies the sustaining provision as fit for use.

structural_cues: 77:25-27 moves from earth-as-kifat through living/dead to stability and water, then the refrain closes the unit at 77:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, life/death, stability, and drink; I infer dependence on the same order being denied and a return into its container. The denied object remains grammatically omitted, so the scene may be evidence against denial without being its exclusive object.

changed_reading.before: Deniers stand outside the proposition they reject.
changed_reading.after: They deny from within an order that contains them alive, sustains them, and receives them dead, making their supposed distance structurally impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imperative releases the addressees into movement specifically toward what they used to declare false. Denial no longer keeps its object at verbal distance; the denied referent becomes an unavoidable destination.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch anchors denial as actively assigning falsehood to an object.
The same declaring-false act appears with an explicit relative object, identifying what becomes the destination.
Unrestrained departure supplies the forced trajectory toward the formerly denied object.

structural_cues: The command at 77:29 is repeated at 77:30, follows the refrain at 77:28, and the destination scene closes with the refrain at 77:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly supplies movement toward 'what you used to deny'; I infer a reversal from speech-act distance to compelled encounter. The imperative can also be read as taunting exposure rather than a literal account of locomotion.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a verbal judgment that keeps its object unreal and remote.
changed_reading.after: The deniers are driven into contact with the very referent they had held at a distance by declaring it false.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those named by an active speech-like denial become unable to speak and receive no permission to offer an excuse. The participle now reads as a completed prior record whose agents can neither renew nor repair their attribution.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a person or report false anchors the earlier speech-act now placed beyond revision.
Excuse and apology supply the unavailable form of retrospective repair.
Speech itself supplies the channel explicitly closed on that day.
Permission and authorization supply the procedural gate that remains shut.

structural_cues: The speechless and excuse-less scene at 77:35-36 is enclosed by the identical refrain at 77:34 and 77:37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no speech, no permission, and no excuse; I infer that the active denial survives only as a fixed prior record. An alternative is simple courtroom incapacity without special lexical interaction with the participle.

changed_reading.before: The deniers remain active disputants who could continue or defend their claim.
changed_reading.after: Their earlier declaration has hardened into the identifying record precisely when speech and apologetic revision are closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A purported shade fails both shading and sufficiency, while the protected receive real shade and present enjoyment is explicitly little. This activates the focus root's peripheral image of a provision that seemed durable but failed expectation: denial can be misplaced confidence in present cover and utility.

activation_trace.role: A milk supply disappearing or not lasting as expected provides the focus-root image of failed provision.
Shelter and protection, explicitly negated in the source construction, supply cover that fails its function.
The same shelter image in the protected scene supplies the functioning counterpart.
Sufficiency, also negated, identifies the failed shade as materially unavailing.
Warding off harm supplies the successful protective relation absent from the false shade.
A remaining span extended for enjoyment supplies present benefit whose duration is under question.
Littleness sharply limits that enjoyment and prevents it from functioning as lasting security.

structural_cues: 77:30-31 negates protective shade, 77:41 gives shade to the protected, and 77:46 commands brief enjoyment; refrains punctuate each contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed cover, real protection, and little enjoyment; I analogize the milk branch's failed expectation from one provision to another. The alternative is a contrast of outcomes with no claim that current provision itself activates k-dh-b.

changed_reading.before: Deniers are defined only by a proposition they reject.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they also embody confidence in present shelter and provision whose apparent adequacy will fail to last.

context_deltas.mechanism: An uttered command meets refusal to lower the body; after the final refrain, the closing question asks what later discourse could produce trusted assent. Denial thus spans heard speech, bodily nonresponse, and the foreclosure of subsequent belief.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in speech or action anchors a form of denial that can be enacted by bodily refusal.
Produced speech supplies the command to which an embodied response is due.
Humility and self-lowering supply the bodily-social relation explicitly refused.
Renewed speech or report supplies the hypothetical later message denied efficacy by the closing question.
Temporal after-ness sets the current discourse as the decisive point beyond which no replacement remains.
Assent that settles the heart supplies the positive response that continued denial blocks.

structural_cues: Refrains at 77:47 and 77:49 bracket the refused command at 77:48, and 77:50 closes the surah by asking about belief after this discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, refusal to bow, later discourse, and belief; I infer a speech-to-body-to-heart response chain. Ruku may remain a specific ritual act rather than a general embodiment of every denial.

changed_reading.before: Mukadhdhibin denotes a primarily verbal or propositional rejection.
changed_reading.after: The label includes refusal enacted by the body and culminates in an inability to grant settled trust to any discourse after this one.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because B007 is a peripheral idiom about a wild creature running a stage and then stopping, not the ordinary sense of the focus participle. It remains anchored in the focus root and is kinetically activated by repeated departure in 77:29-30, but downstream prose should present it only as a movement analogy, never as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B007 stop-after-running image is carried by the same word at 77:19 even though the participial form normally selects active denial.

activation_trace.role: Running for a stage and then stopping to look back supplies an arrested-flight image latent at the focus root.
Departure without restraint activates the running phase of that peripheral focus image.
The explicit object of declaring false keeps the kinetic analogy tied to actual denial rather than free movement imagery.

changed_reading.after: As a contained kinetic analogy, denial runs forward as if escaping, then arrests in retrospective encounter with what it denied.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because B009 concerns patterned cloth whose visible condition deceives, far from the normal agentive sense of mukadhdhibin. Cosmic traces being erased, opened, and uprooted visibly activate a surface-versus-reality analogy anchored in the focus root; downstream prose must mark it as material analogy, not claim that the ayah calls the cosmos deceptive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B009 appearance-that-misreports-itself image offers a peripheral material reading of the active deniers' relation to visible order.

activation_trace.role: A patterned surface that deceives by its condition supplies the focus-root analogy of misleading appearance.
Erasing and wiping away a trace supplies the removal of the apparently stable visible pattern.
Opening a gap between joined sides supplies rupture of the enclosing surface.
Uprooting and removing from place supplies the final unmaking of apparent stability.

changed_reading.before: Deniers merely hold false propositions about a stable visible world.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, they trust a visible pattern as self-reporting reality until the day erases, opens, and removes that pattern.

strongest_changes: The dispatch-reminder-warning-promise sequence turns active denial into an assertion publicly reversed by occurrence and separating judgment.
Exact recurrence makes 77:19 a mobile verdict that specifically seals the first/later destruction sequence rather than an isolated curse.
At 77:29 the formerly denied object becomes the deniers' commanded destination, collapsing verbal distance into encounter.
Speechlessness, refused bowing, and the final belief question extend denial from speech into a fixed record, bodily nonresponse, and failed trust.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed the identical refrain as a recurring classifier across message, history, gestation, earth, punishment, protection, and final response. Peripheral k-dh-b branches also generated contained performance, provision, movement, and surface analogies without replacing the strong active-disconfirmation baseline.
remaining_uncertainties: The object of takdhib is omitted in the focus, so the surrounding scenes may supply several coexisting objects rather than one exhaustive referent.
The refrain's bracket around mujrimun strongly links denial and criminality but does not prove that the two nouns are extensionally identical.
B004, B006, B007, and B009 are legitimate packet branches but remain peripheral enough that downstream prose should preserve their exploratory qualification.
